design_philosophy.name: Soft Swiss Utility
core_principles: Content is King - Typography is the interface
Grid is God - visible or invisible structure

buttons.primary: rounded-none bg-black text-white hover:bg-gray-800 px-6 py-3 font-medium text-sm transition-all
buttons.secondary: rounded-none border border-gray-200 bg-white text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-50 px-6 py-3 font-medium text-sm transition-all

calendar_grid.cell: min-h-[120px] p-2 border-b border-r border-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-50/30 transition-colors relative
calendar_grid.day_header: p-4 text-sm font-bold text-gray-500 border-b border-gray-100 text-center uppercase tracking-widest

modal.content: rounded-none border border-gray-200 shadow-2xl bg-white p-0 sm:max-w-[425px]

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do not use the default centered layout. Use a Sidebar + Main Content layout.
Use Shadcn 'Calendar' component ONLY for the mini-calendar in the sidebar.
Build the Main Calendar View (Month/Week/Day) using CSS Grid (Tailwind 'grid' classes) manually. Do not try to force Shadcn Calendar to stretch.
Event Cards in the grid should have NO border-radius (sharp corners) to match the Swiss aesthetic.
Use the 'empty_state' image for the 404 page or when no events are found in list view.
Typography: Month Title should be massive (text-4xl or 5xl) and aligned Top-Left.
Current Day Indicator: A solid red or black circle/square behind the date number.
Interaction: Clicking a grid cell should open the 'Add Event' dialog.
Interaction: Clicking an event should open the 'Edit Event' dialog.
For icons, use Lucide React (standard with Shadcn).
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles (sharp/pill) relevant to the Swiss style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖 etc.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
